paragraphs: Hyman reports that in Kaftor va-Ferach, chapter 10, page 184b, Luncz edition, the reading at [Temurah 29a](https://www.sefaria.org/Temurah.29a.5-6) is “Beta said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan”; his editions of the Gemara read Baha [בהא].[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Temurah gives Baha speaking in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. [Heilprin’s Baha entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=666&lang=en) and [his Bata entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=822&lang=en) cross-refer to one another.
Hyman reports the Beta reading from the Luncz edition of Kaftor va-Ferach. The exact printed passage remains uncollated.
